mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_group_member (group_id, user_id, role, muted) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{muted})
mapper.select: SELECT id, group_id, user_id, role, muted, created_at FROM chat_group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, group_id, user_id, role, muted, created_at FROM chat_group_member WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, group_id, user_id, role, muted, created_at FROM chat_group_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
